title: Default session export leaked raw test/verify error text and bare file names (failureFingerprint, lastActionSummary, unexpectedFiles) in plain text
repro: Export a session whose retry-loop/diff-ready supervisor evaluations carried a failure fingerprint containing a home path or token, or unexpected files like .env — values appear unhashed despite hash_user_text/hash_file_paths defaults.
notes: Pre-existing; surfaced while reviewing the S-078 replay export. Fixed by extending anonymizer key lists globally, hashing failure_summary value summaries, and redacting secrets before digit masking in the FE fingerprint.
